verification.ee_float_noise_root_cause: EE wall-clock leakage: SIM_START = datetime.now() at human_agent import + EconomicMemory.last_shock_time default = datetime.now() at construction. EE t (and hence R, S) therefore varies ~1e-10 across processes. FSRS is tick-based and unaffected. v1 hid this because pinning clamped EE R to 1.0 exactly. Magnitude negligible vs FSRS-EE gaps ($214,745 W1; $4,934 W2)
verification.sharpe_method: Daily portfolio values from trade tape + prices (positions at round(close,2)); returns = v_t/v_{t-1}-1; Sharpe = mean/std(ddof=0)*sqrt(252), rf=0; dd_daily = max peak-to-trough of daily series; dd_e2e20 = run max_drawdown (20-tick sampling, as v1 headline)
